title: London to New York Time Difference & Converter (UK ↔ NYC)
description: London to New York time difference is usually 5 hours (4 around DST flips). Convert 2pm UK to New York, 8pm NYC to London, pick a date, and share.

mainEntity.name: How many hours between London and New York?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually five. For short windows around the US and UK daylight-saving changes, the difference is four hours. Always confirm with a date.

mainEntity.name: What is 2pm UK time in New York?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a normal 5-hour day, 14:00 in London is 09:00 in New York. Near DST transitions it can be 10:00. use the converter on this page.

mainEntity.name: What is 8pm New York time in London?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a normal 5-hour day, 20:00 in New York is 01:00 the next calendar day in London.

mainEntity.name: Is New York ahead of or behind London?

acceptedAnswer.text: New York is behind London. Morning in London is still night or early morning on the US East Coast.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep both clocks on my Windows desktop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Open World Clock pins city cards above other windows, works offline, and has no ads or telemetry. Free for Windows 10 and 11.
